es: Escribir una queja suave y una petición indirecta a un compañero de departamento, con wish o if only y una pregunta reportada.

vocabulary.es: dejar que los problemas se acumulen

teaching.en: Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I would rather bring up the problem now than let things build up.
teaching.es: Últimamente la cocina ha estado hecha un desastre, y prefiero sacar el problema ahora antes que dejar que las cosas se acumulen.
teaching.explanationEs: Lately describe el problema sin acusar a nadie; bring up y let things build up explican por qué hablas ahora.
segments: Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I would rather
bring up the problem now than let things build up.
teaching.audioText: Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I would rather bring up the problem now than let things build up.

teaching.en: I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day; I do not mean to criticise, only to clear the air.
teaching.es: Ojalá lavaras tus platos el mismo día; no pretendo criticar, solo aclarar las cosas.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + would expresa un deseo sobre una conducta que molesta; clear the air = aclarar las cosas.
segments: I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day;
I do not mean to criticise, only to clear the air.
teaching.audioText: I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day; I do not mean to criticise, only to clear the air.

teaching.en: I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after eleven; you are usually so considerate that I hesitated to ask.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podrías bajar el ruido después de las once; sueles ser tan considerado que dudé en pedírtelo.
teaching.explanationEs: I was wondering if + sujeto + could: petición indirecta; el orden es afirmativo, sin inversión.
segments: I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after
eleven; you are usually so considerate that I hesitated to ask.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after eleven; you are usually so considerate that I hesitated to ask.

teaching.en: I would really appreciate it if you could do a fair share of the cleaning, since we all use the kitchen.
teaching.es: Te agradecería mucho que pudieras hacer una parte justa de la limpieza, ya que todos usamos la cocina.
teaching.explanationEs: I would appreciate it if you could… es una petición muy cortés; a fair share apela a la justicia, no a la culpa.
segments: I would really appreciate it if you could do a fair
share of the cleaning, since we all use the kitchen.
teaching.audioText: I would really appreciate it if you could do a fair share of the cleaning, since we all use the kitchen.

teaching.en: Please don't take it the wrong way, but if only the rota were clearer, nobody would need to complain.
teaching.es: Por favor, no te lo tomes a mal, pero si el calendario de turnos fuera más claro, nadie tendría que quejarse.
teaching.explanationEs: If only + pasado expresa un deseo sobre una situación; take it the wrong way = tomárselo a mal.
segments: Please don't take it the wrong way, but if only
the rota were clearer, nobody would need to complain.
teaching.audioText: Please don't take it the wrong way, but if only the rota were clearer, nobody would need to complain.

teaching.en: Mia asked me whether we could agree on a rota, and I think her suggestion is a fair one.
teaching.es: Mia me preguntó si podíamos acordar un calendario de turnos, y creo que su sugerencia es justa.
teaching.explanationEs: La pregunta reportada con whether mantiene el orden afirmativo y retrocede can a could.

prompt.es: Elige el mensaje que se queja con tacto, sin acusar a nadie.

choices.text: You never wash up, and I am tired of cleaning after you every day.
Everyone knows that you are the messiest person in the building.
Lately the sink has been full; I wish we could agree on a rota.

feedback.es: La queja suave describe el problema con Lately y propone una solución con wish; los otros mensajes acusan con you never o con un insulto.

hint.es: Busca el mensaje que describe el problema y propone algo, sin you never.

origin.text: Leo's flatmate has left dishes in the sink for three days. Leo wants to raise the problem without starting an argument.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ojalá usaras auriculares por la noche.»

feedback.es: Wish + would expresa un deseo sobre una conducta repetida que molesta.

hint.es: Modal de deseo sobre una conducta; empieza por w.

origin.text: The walls are thin and the music is loud after midnight. I wish you ___ use your headphones late at night.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me preguntaba si podrías ordenar la cocina esta noche.»

answer.text: I was wondering if you could tidy the kitchen tonight
accepted: I was wondering if you could tidy the kitchen tonight
I was wondering if tonight you could tidy the kitchen

feedback.es: I was wondering if + sujeto + could + verbo: petición indirecta con orden afirmativo.

hint.es: Empieza por I was wondering if y sigue sin invertir.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué busca Leo con su mensaje.

choices.text: To warn Sam that he will stop cleaning unless the rota changes.
To apologise for the mess that he has left in the flat lately.
To propose a fairer way to share the cleaning without blaming Sam.
To arrange a chat on Sunday so that Sam can explain himself.

feedback.es: Leo describe el problema, propone un turno y aclara que no culpa a nadie: busca repartir la limpieza; la charla del domingo es solo el medio, no el fin.

origin.audio: Hi Sam, it's Leo. Lately the flat has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and I wondered whether we could agree on a rota. I don't want to blame anyone; I just wish we could keep it tidy together. Would Sunday suit you for a quick chat?

prompt.es: Elige la pregunta de Mia bien reportada.

choices.text: Mia asked whether could we agree on a rota.
Mia asked whether we could agree on a rota.
Mia asked that we could agree on a rota.

feedback.es: Una pregunta reportada con whether mantiene el orden afirmativo; la inversión y that + could son errores.

origin.text: Mia asked the flatmates: «Can we agree on a rota?»

prompt.es: Reformula la petición de forma indirecta con I was wondering if.

answer.text: I was wondering if you could turn the music down.
accepted: I was wondering if you could turn the music down.
I was wondering whether you could turn the music down.
I was wondering if you would turn the music down.
I was wondering if you could turn down the music.

feedback.es: La petición directa se suaviza con I was wondering if + sujeto + could + verbo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué pretende Ana con su mensaje a Leo?

choices.text: To raise a small problem politely and suggest a shared solution.
To complain about Leo's behaviour and demand a formal apology.
To announce that Mia will draw up the cleaning rota alone.
To ask Leo for the money he owes for the shared cleaning supplies.

feedback.es: Ana describe un problema pequeño, evita acusar y propone una solución compartida; no exige disculpas ni anuncia decisiones.

origin.text: Hi Leo, I hope your exams are going well. I wanted to mention something small before it grows. Lately the hall has been full of bags, and I have nearly tripped twice. I'm sure you don't notice it, and I certainly don't want you to take this the wrong way. I wish we had a place for them, and I was wondering if you could keep your things in your room during the week. I would really appreciate it, and I'll do the same with my shoes. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota too, which might help us both. Shall we chat on Sunday? Thanks, Ana

prompt.es: ¿Qué sugiere Ana con la frase «I'll do the same with my shoes»?

choices.text: That she wants Leo to feel guilty by comparing his bags with her shoes.
That she accepts causing some mess too and will change her habits.
That she thinks the mess in the hall is entirely Leo's fault.
That she plans to buy a new shelf to settle the matter.

feedback.es: Al ofrecerse a hacer lo mismo, Ana reconoce su parte del problema y reparte la responsabilidad en vez de culpar solo a Leo.

feedback.es: Bring up + the subject es el verbo frasal habitual para sacar un tema; fíjate en que up ya está en la frase.

origin.text: I didn't want to ___ up the subject of the rota in front of everyone, so I sent Mia a private message instead.

prompt.es: Escribe a Sam: problema, deseo, petición indirecta, pregunta reportada y cierre.

answer.text: Hi Sam, I hope your week is going well. I wanted to bring something up before it gets awkward. Lately the kitchen has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and the music has been loud after eleven. I'm sure you don't notice it, and please don't take it the wrong way, because I don't want to blame anyone. I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day, and if only the walls were thicker, I would not need to mention the music at all. I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after eleven, and I would really appreciate it if you could tidy up tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota, so that everyone does a fair share, and I think it is a good idea. Could we talk about it this weekend? Thanks for being so considerate; I hope this helps to clear the air.
accepted: Hi Sam, I hope your week is going well. I wanted to bring something up before it gets awkward. Lately the kitchen has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and the music has been loud after eleven. I'm sure you don't notice it, and please don't take it the wrong way, because I don't want to blame anyone. I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day, and if only the walls were thicker, I would not need to mention the music at all. I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after eleven, and I would really appreciate it if you could tidy up tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota, so that everyone does a fair share, and I think it is a good idea. Could we talk about it this weekend? Thanks for being so considerate; I hope this helps to clear the air.

Hello Sam, I wanted to write to you about the flat before things build up. Lately the kitchen has been untidy, and the music has been loud late at night. I am not angry, and I am sure it is easily done. I wish you would tidy up after cooking, and if only the walls were thicker, it would be easier for me to sleep. I was wondering if you could turn the music down after eleven. I would appreciate it if you could clean the kitchen tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a rota for the cleaning, and I think it would help all of us to share the work in a fair way. Could we talk about it on Sunday? Thank you for understanding, and please tell me if anything bothers you, too.

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje describe sin acusar, expresa un deseo, pide de forma indirecta, reporta una pregunta y cierra con agradecimiento.

origin.text: Vives con un compañero, Sam. Escríbele un mensaje de unas 190–250 palabras: describe el problema (cocina desordenada y música tarde) sin acusar; expresa un deseo con wish o if only; haz una petición indirecta con I was wondering if…; incluye una pregunta reportada (Mia te preguntó si podían acordar un turno de limpieza); y termina agradeciendo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud transmite esta nota pegada en la nevera?

choices.text: Resigned, suggesting that the flatmates will never change their habits.
Apologetic, taking the blame for the state of the kitchen herself.
Gentle, naming the problem while avoiding any blame.
Firm, presenting the rota as a rule that starts on Monday.

feedback.es: Nombra el problema, aclara que nadie tiene la culpa y propone probar un turno con un «Shall we?»: tono suave, no resignado, culpable ni autoritario.

origin.text: Dear flatmates, thank you all for being so patient lately. I wish I could say that the kitchen is tidy, but I think we all know that it is not. No one is to blame, and I'm not angry; I just think a rota might save us from ever having this conversation again. Mia asked whether we could try it from Monday. Shall we?

prompt.es: Ordena: «Leo preguntó si podía mantener el ruido bajo.»

answer.text: Leo asked whether I could keep the noise down

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada conserva el orden afirmativo: whether + I + could + keep the noise down.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué sugiere la hablante sobre la basura.

choices.text: That one flatmate has ignored the bins on purpose for several weeks.
That she will take out the bins herself every Thursday from now on.
That the rota is unfair because she already takes out the bins alone.
That the bins should be added to the rota so work is shared.

feedback.es: La hablante describe el problema sin acusar y propone incluir la basura en los turnos para repartir el trabajo.

origin.audio: I don't want to complain, but lately the bins have not been taken out. I wish someone would do it on Thursdays. I was wondering if we could put it on the rota, so that nobody feels they are doing more than a fair share.
